content: python-can supports BLF, ASC, MDF4(mf4), candump-log, CSV writers. BLFWriter append mode is buggy (issue #1751, doesn't take effect). MF4Writer has no append mode; MDF4 needs a finalization step, asammdf attempts best-effort recovery of unfinalized files but not all steps supported. ASC/candump-log/CSV are plain-text/line-based and append-safe by construction. canmatrix 1.2 (Feb 2025) handles DBC<->other format conversion. Recommendation: use MCAP (purpose-built append-only/crash-safe/chunked) as primary archive; export to MDF4/ASC/BLF post-session for tool compatibility.
